1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not chemically disrupt the embryo cells__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and does not include cell-disrupting chemicals__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __physically disrupting the shed cellular material through__ cold and then heat followed by agitation.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __without chemical treatment__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme __selected to preserve embryo viability__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME® __or another cell wall degrading enzyme__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __purifying and__ extracting the DNA __using magnetic particle-based separation or other non-destructive extraction methods__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and separating the magnetic particles from the solution__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at the time of collection of shed cellular material__.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from the shed cellular material without destruction of the embryo__.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the extracted DNA__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germination__, __wherein the selection is made without destroying the embryo__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after genotype-based selection__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using computer-controlled systems__.
